Children sketch history of Liberation War
2014-04-02T00:00:00+06:00 | Aminul Islam, Mymensingh
https://www.thedailystar.net/children-sketch-history-of-liberation-war-18248

Children sketched the history of the Liberation War in a painting competition to mark the 44th Independence Day celebrations. Shilpacharya Zainul Abedin Sangrahashala (art gallery) organised the competition at the art gallery the premises on Friday afternoon. Deputy keeper of the art gallery Dr. Bijoy Krishna Banik inaugurated the competition. A total of 143 children from different educational institutions of class one to ten took part in the competition in four groups. The subjects of the competition were-open choice, women Freedom Fighters, Mujibnagar Government and killing of intellectuals by anti-liberation forces. Twelve children from four groups who were awarded prizes are Mahia Islam, Redwan Ahmed, Tahir Afsar, Masrafi Mustafa, Galib Ahsan, Rawnak Jahan, Sheshashdri Sannyal, Khandaker Shahrier, Puspita Tahsin, Rakib Ahmed and Fahmun Siddiqua Chowdhury. In his inaugural speech, Dr. Banik said through such competitions, children will learn about the true history of the Liberation War and will remember the historic event.
